## Execution update — 2026-10-09 06:08 UTC

The first [surface-window controls run](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37890734575) completed successfully on the exact head `275e8799d4947d297329073eaa3ca675d3fd0777` (attempt 1). Author and independent root audits consumed the complete original 114,785-byte ZIP: all 21 members, source/observer before-and-after receipts, six command records, and full stdout/stderr.

The original v15 proof, workspace formatting, scoped Clippy and all **10 exact Rust methods (6 new + 3 existing dependency controls + 1 existing stale-build control)** passed. The targeted methods had zero failed, ignored or measured cases. All 1,089 product input hashes match the approved registry before and after execution.

The 54 bounded surface fixtures record 18 → 9 SQL statements each; the 36 existing dependency fixtures record 8 → 4. These fixture counters establish removal of duplicate queries, with no claim about 100k or whole-build wall-clock improvement. This PR's full original CI is still being reviewed separately.

## Problem

A prepare pass already materializes a bounded public-surface candidate window, then can issue the same pending-work SQL again at its tail. Reuse that actual window when the final seed list exactly matches the queried list and admission stays within the original budget.

## Change and resulting behavior

- Keep the window local to one prepare call. Preserve the original SQL fallback when seeds expand, the window is missing, or admission bounds do not match.
- Preserve the existing unconditional prepared-build epoch check, transactional fences, candidate ordering, budgets, and cursor behavior.
- Add six focused Rust controls covering SQL equivalence, exact-basis requirements, replacement/removal/reopen, promotion behavior, expanded-seed fallback, and external-write epoch rejection.
- Add one fixed-head controls workflow that also runs the three existing dependency-window controls and the existing stale-prepared-build test.
- Follow #170: retain its reviewed snapshot batching product and current validation integration. The additional production change is confined to reconcile.rs. #170 remains available with its own actual CI evidence.
